column1: # Example items file for scripts/mac-exit/nongit-homing.sh. Every name and path below is made up: copy this file,
# replace the rows with your own directories, and run  nongit-homing.sh dry  on it first.
# Four TAB-separated columns (an editor that turns tabs into spaces breaks the file):
#   name          label used in logs and in the per-item RESULT.txt line; unique
#   source_dir    absolute, or starting with $HOME/ or ~/ (nothing else is expanded); a directory or one regular file
#   dest_rel      where it lands under the run directory; relative, no '..'; unique. For a single-file source it must
#                 end in that file's name. Mirroring the source below $HOME as home/<path> keeps runs easy to compare.
#   exclude_globs optional, ';'-separated, matched against paths relative to source_dir (and against each basename).
#                 "=name" carves a top-level entry out because ANOTHER item copies it (see the last two rows).
# Credential-looking files and directories, dataless cloud placeholders, sockets and FIFOs are never copied no matter
# what is written here; they are only listed, by name and size, in the run's EXCLUDED.tsv.
